text: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in ADONAI are like Mount Zion — it cannot be moved, but endures forever.
As the mountains are around Jerusalem, so ADONAI is all around His people, both now and forever.
For a scepter of wickedness will not rest over the land of the righteous — lest the righteous set their hands to evil.
Do good, ADONAI, to the good, and to those upright in their hearts.
But as for those who turn aside to their crooked ways, ADONAI will lead them away with evildoers. Shalom be upon Israel.
